summary:
[  edit  ]
The Polyreduce  SOP  reduces a high detail polygonal model into one consisting of fewer polygons. The second input's polygons represent feature edges. They are matched to the input mesh by point numbers.
The methods to reduce polygonal models are:
A percentage of their former size
A specfic number of polys (within a few)
According to distance from a camera
Note that as it requires (and outputs) a triangular mesh, the polygon count may increase as a result of this operation.
A second input for feature edges is provided.

parameters.label: Polygons
parameters.name: reduce
parameters.description: The polygons which will be candidates for simplification. Other polygons which share points with these might also be affected.

parameters.label: Features
parameters.name: creases
parameters.description: Which polygons are feature edges.

parameters.label: Method
parameters.name: method
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select how to reduce the number of polygons from the following methods.

parameters.label: Percentage
parameters.name: percentage
parameters.description: Choose reduction level with a percentage.

parameters.label: Number
parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Choose reduction level by number of polygons.

parameters.label: Distance
parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Reduce polygons based on distance to an object.

parameters.label: Keep %
parameters.name: percentage
parameters.description: Specify the percentage of polygons to keep when Method set to 'Percentage'.

parameters.label: Keep #
parameters.name: numpolys
parameters.description: Specify the number of polygons to keep when Method set to 'Number'.

parameters.label: Object
parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: The object to use as a reference.

parameters.label: Dist. Threshhold
parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: The world distance at which the polygons should be left at full detail.

parameters.label: Minimum %
parameters.name: minpercent
parameters.description: A lower bound to the level of reduction.

parameters.label: Stiffen Border
parameters.name: borderweight
parameters.description: Without any constraints, the edges of planar surfaces can erode. This controls a bias which penalizes such erosion.

parameters.label: Stiffen Features
parameters.name: creaseweight
parameters.description: The amount of penalty to add to the feature edges being eroded.

parameters.label: Equalize Edges
parameters.name: lengthweight
parameters.description: This bias penalizes the removal of long edges. It tends to reduce high aspect ratio triangles at the expense of more uniform reduction.

parameters.label: Prevent Mesh Inversion
parameters.name: meshinvert
parameters.description: When enabled, each reduction is tested to see if it would flip a triangle normal. While encurring a slight cost, the results are almost always worth it.

parameters.label: Pre-Triangulate
parameters.name: triangulate
parameters.description: As only triangular polygons will be reduced, this option will automatically triangulate the input polygons.

parameters.label: Prevent Cracking
parameters.name: keepedges
parameters.description: This prohibits the removal of any edge that occurs at the boundary of the polygons. This ensures no cracks develop with unreduced areas.

parameters.label: Use Original Points
parameters.name: originalpoints
parameters.description: When it collapses edges, it will use one of the two original points instead of finding the optimal interior point.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims

parameters.label: num_particles
